decision_contract: This is an anchor-preserving paired structural sensitivity audit, not recalibration, confirmation or a policy scenario.
Every existing ART-initiation and diagnosis anchor remains exactly unchanged.
Betas, contacts, mixing, PrEP, seeding, progression and all parameter values remain fixed.
Hazard-linear and smoothstep profiles change only the path between ART anchors; stepwise is an explicit boundary test.
The MSM log-linear profiles reproduce the best diagnosis-geometry signal from the preceding temporal audit and test interaction with ART interpolation only.
A useful response must improve diagnosis RMSE and diagnostic primary I_max without worsening 2022 AIDS absolute error.
No profile may enter calibration or the HTA baseline directly from this audit.
